question: dame los motivos de devolución con su número de devoluciones y su importe total en euros, ordenados por número de devoluciones
sql: SELECT refund_reason, COUNT(*) AS refund_count, SUM(refund_amount_eur_minor) / 100.0 AS total_refund_eur FROM fact_refund GROUP BY refund_reason ORDER BY refund_count DESC
